proposed_raw_schema_contract.status: unapproved; based on verified payload and official definitions
proposed_raw_schema_contract.tables: Preserve PUBACC_HD (59 columns) and PUBACC_LO (51 columns) with exact official SQL names, order, values, and precision; retain the original .dat files losslessly. PUBACC_LO names from official definitions: record_type, unique_system_identifier, uls_file_number, ebf_number, call_sign, location_action_performed, location_type_code, location_class_code, location_number, site_status, corresponding_fixed_location, location_address, location_city, location_county, location_state, radius_of_operation, area_of_operation_code, clearance_indicator, ground_elevation, lat_degrees, lat_minutes, lat_seconds, lat_direction, long_degrees, long_minutes, long_seconds, long_direction, max_lat_degrees, max_lat_minutes, max_lat_seconds, max_lat_direction, max_long_degrees, max_long_minutes, max_long_seconds, max_long_direction, nepa, quiet_zone_notification_date, tower_registration_number, height_of_support_structure, overall_height_of_structure, structure_type, airport_id, location_name, units_hand_held, units_mobile, units_temp_fixed, units_aircraft, units_itinerant, status_code, status_date, earth_agree.
proposed_raw_schema_contract.identity: Identity is the source pair (unique_system_identifier, location_number); unique_system_identifier replaces call_sign per FCC intro doc. Do not promote row numbers or generate substitute IDs.
proposed_raw_schema_contract.drift_policy: Field-count or name change vs the official definitions, changed status mix, or coverage/geometry drift requires quarantine and maintainer review. FCC documents type changes (2026-07-20 notice); watch for future notices.

published_contract.status: pending maintainer approval and accepted-baseline comparison
published_contract.candidate_reconstruction: One point feature per PUBACC_LO row whose PUBACC_HD license is active (license_status='A'), geometry from lat/long DMS fields (degrees/minutes/seconds/direction) converted to decimal degrees (EPSG:4326); carry source columns including unique_system_identifier, location_number, call_sign, tower_registration_number, structure_type, heights, site fields. Status filter and column mapping are proposals requiring approval, not silent defaults.
published_contract.baseline: No accepted HIFLD Next dataset/version verified; former HIFLD copy (6,541 features) vs current active-license reconstruction (6,389 locations) difference needs an accepted-baseline decision.

refresh_and_idempotency.cadence: weekly complete file (created early Sunday); ingest should version by the counts-file creation date, not fetch time
refresh_and_idempotency.idempotency_key: sha256 of l_paging.zip plus counts-file creation date
refresh_and_idempotency.completeness_gate: row counts from the counts file must match parsed rows per table; HD/LO join coverage reported
refresh_and_idempotency.quarantine: Do not replace an accepted release when the file is incomplete, schema-drifted, or cannot be authenticated as FCC.
